title: Trump, Xi, and the Race for Superintelligence
text:
ChinaTalk's Jordan Schneider, an adjunct senior fellow at the Center for a New American Security, joins Jerusalem Demsas and Matt Yglesias to compare how the U.S. and China are approaching artificial intelligence. They dive into the Trump-Xi summit, whether AI will change how politicians govern, and the limits of what Chinese AI models are allowed to say. They also discuss the gap in public opinion: why do so many people in China have positive expectations for AI while Americans are dooming?
Listen to the full interview on The Argument.
